name: MPWG RALA
author: James
description: Phase 3 piecewise RALA ramp (2026-09-rala-p3a). Linear RGBA between James's RadarScope calibration anchors, not a generic smooth gradient and not a saturation boost. Anchors: 2.0 subtle weak return, 10.3 weak green, 24.8 medium green, 31.7 strong green approaching yellow, 39.7 yellow-orange transition, 48.3 orange, 56.4 red, 64.7 magenta/pink core. Bookends at -32 (fainter valid wisp) and 75 (pale pink above the core) only extend that piecewise ramp. No cyan/aqua stop. No-echo and missing stay alpha 0 via the category mask. Valid very-low dBZ stays visible. display_min_dbz=-32. Composite keeps mpwg-clean-2026-09.

stops.label: 75+ dBZ pale pink above the core
